articles.description: Donald Trump hails Huang as a ‘great patriot and national treasure’ after his surprise reinstatement as Nvidia’s CEO Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO Shares in UK housebuilder Crest Nicholson have slumped by a quarter, to a record low, after the company issued a profits warning this morning. Full year completions were 1,353, at the bottom end of the Group’s previous guidance range of 1,350 to 1,400 completions. The warning has hammered Crest Nicholson shares, which have lost more than a quarter of their value this morning, currently trading down over 30%. The brutal sell-off is also weighing on the wider sector, dragging peers like Barratt Redrow, Persimmon, Vistry and Bellway into the red. Today’s update suggests that weakness in the housing market is no longer confined to first-time buyers. Crest Nicholson is predominantly exposed to the mid-premium family housing market, and the sharp deterioration in sales rates indicates that more affluent upsizers are also becoming increasingly cautious amid macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty. Continue reading...
